I have tried reindexing a single dataset by persistent ID and dataset ID, but the Solr query result still says it is unpublished (it should be published since I have done so). May I know if there are logs that I should check? I'm not sure what could be the reasons behind this failure...

Please see the following screenshot for your information.

I may try the Reindex in place option, since it seems not inducing service downtime.
For the following command (Clear Index Timestamps), what is expected to see / happen after entering?

  • curl -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/api/admin/index/timestamps

Is there any confirmation we have to make before proceeding to the following command (Start or Continue Async Reindex)?

  • curl http://localhost:8080/api/admin/index/continue

Thank you so much Philip for your advise :folded_hands: , we have had this issue for about a week.
I can't think of any confirmation you should make before moving on to that "continue" step.
